obdNotice.title: Before you connect
obdNotice.examplesOther: or other ELM327 clones with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)
obdNotice.bleOnlyHint: Only Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) is supported — adapters with only classic Bluetooth or Wi-Fi don't work with this app.
obdNotice.safetyWarning: Use diagnostics only when the vehicle is stationary, never while driving: it is dangerous and illegal.
obdNotice.intro: You'll need an OBD2 Bluetooth adapter to plug into your car's OBD2 port (usually under the steering wheel).
obdNotice.webExamplesIntro: For example, adapters with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE):
obdNotice.nativeStep1: Plug in the adapter and turn the ignition on.
obdNotice.nativeStep2: Pair it through the Android Bluetooth settings (the PIN is usually 1234 or 0000). You only need to do this once.
obdNotice.nativeStep3: Come back here and select the adapter from the list.
obdNotice.nativeCompat: Only ELM327 adapters with classic Bluetooth work (look for "Bluetooth 3.0" or "Classic" in the description). BLE-only ("Bluetooth 4.0") and Wi-Fi adapters do not work.
obdNotice.nativeFailHint: If it won't pair even through the Android settings, it's usually the adapter: cheaper models are sometimes defective.
obdNotice.readOnly: The app only reads data: it does not change or erase anything in the vehicle.
obdNotice.notGuaranteed: Compatibility with your car and adapter is not guaranteed: many cheap models are unreliable clones.

disclaimer.title: Important notices
disclaimer.intro: Before using Diario Auto, please read and accept the following:
points: Do not use the app while driving: it is dangerous and illegal. Check the data only when the vehicle is stationary.
Data read from the vehicle is indicative, may be wrong or incomplete, and does not replace a diagnosis by a qualified mechanic.
Do not make safety decisions based only on the app: with red warning lights, noises or unusual behaviour, stop and go to a garage.
Compatibility with your car, phone and OBD2 adapter is not guaranteed. Many cheap adapters are unreliable clones: you use them at your own risk.
OBD2 diagnostics only reads vehicle data: the app does not change or erase anything in the vehicle's control unit.
Deadlines, reminders and costs are only an aid: responsibility for inspections, servicing, insurance and road tax remains yours.

The app is provided "as is", without warranties. To the extent permitted by law, the author is not liable for damage to the vehicle, the phone or any other damage arising from its use. Your statutory consumer rights are not affected.
